setup.title: AI watchlist
setup.intro: Four videos and one 1950 paper. 7 hours 42 minutes of watching. Start here if you want to understand AI.
needs: Three of the videos and the paper are free. iHuman is a film you may need to rent or stream.

steps.title: The Thinking Game
steps.body: Film, 1h 24m. Five years inside DeepMind with Demis Hassabis. You see the setbacks, then the moment AlphaFold works. [Watch on YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=d95J8yzvjbQ)

steps.title: iHuman
steps.body: Film, 1h 39m. A 2019 film on AI, power and surveillance. It asks who gains control when AI is deployed. [See where to watch it](https://watch.plex.tv/movie/ihuman)

steps.title: The A.I. Dilemma
steps.body: Talk, 1h 07m. Tristan Harris and Aza Raskin argue that social media was our first contact with AI. Recorded before GPT-4. [Watch on YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xoVJKj8lcNQ)

steps.title: Deep Dive into LLMs like ChatGPT
steps.body: Lecture, 3h 31m. Andrej Karpathy walks through how these models are trained and why they hallucinate. No coding needed. [Watch on YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7xTGNNLPyMI)

steps.title: Computing Machinery and Intelligence
steps.body: Paper, 1950. Alan Turing asks "Can machines think?", then swaps it for a test: the imitation game. [Read the PDF](https://courses.cs.umbc.edu/471/papers/turing.pdf)
